synonyms: Atelier of the Demon King
synopsis: Demon Lord Yami, exhausted by the prolonged war, begs Hero Lux to "kill her." But the hero couldn't bring himself to kill the lonely girl. And Yami fell in love for the first time. Lux faked the Demon Lord's death and ended the war. However, their peaceful life together didn't last long, and Lux ​​died of illness. In her despair, Yami delivered his ashes to his hometown, where she found his younger brother, Ray, who bore a striking resemblance to him. With nowhere else to go, Yami hides her true identity and takes up residence in the accessory workshop run by Ray. Eventually, she realizes that the Demon Lord's magic brings about mysterious miracles for the owners of the accessories—… A story of rebirth unfolds in a world without a hero. (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

synopsis: After spending over a century hiding in the shadows, powerful sorceress Sadako stumbles upon the dazzling world of social media and decides to post her way into her first real contact with humanity. synopsis: Jiang Shu is a graduate student in the History Department. When she accidentally travels back in time to the Qi dynasty, she remembers exactly how the history went. She knows that Qi Changning is a famously tyrannical queen, regarded as a villainess in the history books. Jiang Shu was content to play along and act like an obsequious lap-dog in order to survive. However, as she spends more time with the queen, she discovers details hidden from the history books. The "demon queen" doesn't seem to be as bad as what she had read… (Source: Bilibili, translated)

titleEnglish: Even a Replica Can Fall in Love
titleNative: レプリカだって、恋をする。
synonyms: Even a Replica Falls in Love
รักฉันเทียมเธอ
synopsis: On days when Sunao is sick, or not feeling like going to school, she is called to take her place. She was born to this world when Sunao wished to have a substitute. No one knows that she exists, but she tries to do her best for Sunao whenever she is called. One day she talks with Sanada, one of her classmates. They become friends, but soon he notices that she is different from the original Sunao...he was the first one who did. She tells him to talk with her only when she has her hair half-up. Sanada does like she told him, and they enjoy their time together. As they become closer, she realizes that she has special feelings toward Sanada. But she doesn't know what will happen to her...if she, a replica, falls in love. (Source: BookWalker)
